purpose: Read-only current-revision review of the proposed $02A0-$02BF HUD snapshot range; current source-phase audit supports it as a candidate, but no allocation decision was made.

keybinding_indexed_store.source_check: key_capture loads the shared selection index from $E0, compares it with KB_ACTION_COUNT, and branches to kc_reject when the value is 5 or greater before storing through B,X.
keybinding_indexed_store.emitted_listing: $BBDF loads $E0; $BBE1 compares #5; $BBE3 branches to kc_reject on unsigned >=5; $BBE5 loads the captured key; $BBE8 performs STA B,X.
keybinding_indexed_store.bounded_destination: Valid B values 0..4 write $0287..$028B. This emitted path cannot write $02A0..$02BF.
keybinding_indexed_store.conclusion: The earlier 2026-11-02 concern about this keybinding store reaching the proposed snapshot range does not apply to this current built revision.

range_review.literal_search: Searched shipped src/ and scripts/ for literal $02A0..$02BF and exact endpoint forms. The only match is a comment in src/audio_runtime.s describing boot tables ending at $02BF; it is not a storage declaration.
range_review.mapping: The current source initializes PAR0 to physical page $38. No separate PAR0 register reference was found after startup setup; the current documented runtime borrowers change PAR1..PAR5. PAR0 would therefore keep the candidate CPU range visible while PAR5 changes, subject to the existing mapping contract.
range_review.remaining: The range remains unallocated. A future implementation must assign a runtime owner, clear the snapshot after boot-table retirement and before the first HUD read, and preserve PAR0=$38. This is a current-revision conclusion, not a guarantee for future source revisions or external probes.

boot_phase_audit.retirement: The boot descriptor table retires at boot_streams_retired before runtime initialization.
boot_phase_audit.result: No receipt-bound generated boot copy range or compressed destination page overlaps candidate $02A0-$02BF. The source declarations at $0287-$029F, audio start at $02C0, bootstrap scratch at $02F0-$02FE, and protected stack window $1E00-$1FFF also do not overlap it.

capacity_context.presentation_module: 1260/1280 bytes; 20 bytes free, measured by the existing matching build receipt for this revision.
capacity_context.active_cycle_target: 27000 cycles, as recorded by RSCH-018; no timing measurement was made for a shared HUD design.

execution: No build, test, emulator, runtime, source edit, or memory allocation was performed for this review.
